payload.name: Extract-All-Enumerated-Items
payload.description: When a user message contains multiple listed pieces of advice, preferences, facts, or requirements, use during extraction to capture every item instead of only the first few.
content: When extracting candidates from a message that presents several distinct items in a list (numbered, bulleted, or natural-language 'also/and'), include all enumerated items. Combine them into one candidate if they share a subject, or create separate candidates; do not drop trailing items. Before finalizing an extraction candidate, recheck the raw message to confirm every listed item is represented.

solves: Diagnosed cause: extraction candidate omitted the last piece of advice from an enumerated list, so later ADD only persisted partial information. The abstraction: any extraction step must treat enumerations as complete sets and preserve every listed item. This applies whenever future messages contain multiple distinct advice, preferences, or facts in one utterance; it does not require knowing the gold answer and is not limited to a particular topic.
